retired.question: What is the name of the elevated transit ride in Tomorrowland at Magic Kingdom?

retained.question: Magic Kingdom's Tomorrowland Transit Authority PeopleMover moves its cars without onboard engines, relying instead on what propulsion system embedded in the track?

rationale: The retained propulsion question explicitly names the Magic Kingdom PeopleMover and adds its motor fact. This repeats the simple elevated-transit identity.

sources.locator: Title; Move Above and Beyond; Magnet-Powered Magic
sources.evidence: Tomorrowland Transit Authority PeopleMover is the elevated Tomorrowland tram powered by linear induction motors.
sources.limitations: Primary institutional text inspected; no film or video viewing claimed.

originalOptionAssessments.assessment: The official title is Tomorrowland Transit Authority PeopleMover.
WEDway Express is not the title.
Future Commuter is not the title.
Tomorrowland Monorail is not the elevated tram's title.
